meta.document: arXiv 2610.30074v1 - Parallel AI Agent Collaboration as Graph-Structured Distributed Block Optimization (Li, Demidovich, Richtarik, KAUST)
meta.coverage: Pages 1-8 of the PDF (abstract, theory, experiments). Appendix (pages 9-24) is not covered.
meta.scoring: must = list of keyword groups. A group passes if ANY keyword in it matches; the answer is correct only if ALL groups pass. Keywords starting with 're:' are regexes, others are whitespace/underscore-insensitive substring matches. evidence = strings that should appear in the retrieved chunks (retrieval hit).

questions.question: Is paper ka title kya hai?
questions.expected_answer: Parallel AI Agent Collaboration as Graph-Structured Distributed Block Optimization.

questions.question: Paper ke authors kaun kaun hain?
questions.expected_answer: Hanmin Li, Yury Demidovich aur Peter Richtárik.

questions.question: Authors kis university se hain aur wo kahan located hai?
questions.expected_answer: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), Thuwal, Saudi Arabia.
evidence: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology

questions.question: Is paper ka arXiv ID kya hai?
Abstract ke hisaab se ye paper kis coordination problem ko model karta hai?
questions.expected_answer: Parallel AI agents ke useful local edits jab combine kiye jate hain to shared solution degrade ho sakta hai. Is coordination ko discrete block optimization problem ki tarah model kiya gaya hai, jisme exactly evaluable objective aur known dependency graph hai.

questions.question: Safe merger total verified local improvement ka kitna fraction preserve karta hai?
questions.expected_answer: Safe merger total verified local improvement ka 1/χ_f(G) fraction preserve karta hai, jahan χ_f(G) dependency graph ka fractional chromatic number hai.

questions.question: Running example me pricing, checkout aur receipt edits ke individual verified gains kitne the?
questions.expected_answer: Pricing +2, checkout +2, receipt +1.

questions.question: Teeno edits ek saath merge karne par gain kitna milta hai, aur compatible pricing-receipt pair ka gain kitna hai?
questions.expected_answer: Teeno merge karne par gain sirf 1 milta hai, jabki compatible pricing-receipt pair ka gain 3 hai (jo optimum tak pahunchta hai).

questions.question: Running example ka objective function F(x) kya hai?
Dependency graph G kaise banta hai?
questions.expected_answer: Dependency graph G me vertices blocks hote hain; do blocks b aur c ke beech edge tab hota hai jab koi objective factor dono par depend karta ho.

questions.question: Singleton verification kya hota hai?
questions.expected_answer: Har proposal ko common base artifact par alag se evaluate kiya jata hai (baaki blocks unchanged). Proposal tabhi retain hota hai jab valid ho, time budget me aaye aur F ko reduce kare; gain g = F(x) − F(x_−b, Y) ≥ 0 hota hai.

questions.question: Fractional coloring kya hai aur uska constraint kya hai?
questions.expected_answer: Fractional coloring independent sets I ko non-negative weights λ_I deta hai taaki har block total weight ≥ 1 se cover ho; total weight Λ(λ) ka minimum χ_f(G) (fractional chromatic number) hai.

questions.question: Theorem 1 (certified gain retention) kya kehta hai?
questions.expected_answer: Theorem 1: F(x^k) − F(x^{k,safe}) ≥ (1/Λ) Σ g ≥ 0. Optimal fractional coloring me Λ = χ_f(G), isliye safe merge kam se kam 1/χ_f(G) fraction of total verified singleton gain retain karta hai.
evidence: every realization of the agent proposals

questions.question: Theorem 2 (tightness) ka matlab kya hai?
questions.expected_answer: Theorem 2 batata hai ki bound tight hai: koi bhi coordinator jo submitted proposals me se subset select karta hai, worst case me 1/χ_f(G) se zyada fraction guarantee nahi kar sakta.

questions.question: Ordinary κ-coloring use karne par kitna fraction guarantee milta hai?
questions.expected_answer: Ordinary proper κ-coloring se 1/κ fraction guarantee milta hai (Corollary 3).

questions.question: Interaction surplus kya hai aur running example me uski value kitni hai?
questions.expected_answer: Interaction surplus I_k(S) = F(x^k) − F(x^{k,S}) − Σ g. Running example me full union ka gain 1 hai jabki singleton gains ka sum 5 hai, isliye surplus −4 hai.

questions.question: Algorithm 1 (Optimistic Integration) ek round me kya karta hai?
questions.expected_answer: Assignment choose karke proposals deadline h tak collect karta hai, har proposal ko x^k par verify karke gains nikalta hai, best independent set se safe candidate banata hai aur full-union candidate banata hai. Agar union valid hai to safe aur union me se kam F wala chunta hai, warna safe candidate; phir broadcast karta hai.

questions.question: Proposition 4 ke according optimistic rule safe rule se kaise compare karta hai?
questions.expected_answer: Optimistic rule safe rule jaisa hi per-round guarantee (≥ (1/Λ) Σ g) preserve karta hai, aur gain max{G_safe, G_all} hota hai, yaani safe aur full-union me se bada gain.

questions.question: Assumption 2 (conditional local improvement) me η ka kya matlab hai?
questions.expected_answer: Assumption 2: E[g_ib | H, M] ≥ η_ib(h) D_b(x^k). η_ib agent i ki block b par expected quality batata hai, best single-block improvement D_b ke relative. η = 1/2 ka matlab agent expectation me kam se kam aadha improvement recover karta hai.

questions.question: Assumption 3 (block error bound) kya hai aur μ ka matlab kya hai?
questions.expected_answer: Assumption 3: Σ_b D_b(x^k) ≥ μ Δ(x^k) for some μ ∈ (0,1]. μ batata hai ki remaining global gap kitna blockwise improvements se visible hai. Separable loss me μ = 1.

questions.question: Block error bound ke liye jo two-block example F(x1,x2) = 1 + x1 + x2 − 3x1x2 diya hai, usme kya hota hai?
questions.expected_answer: (0,0) par loss 1 hai; ek block badalne se loss 2 ho jata hai, dono badalne se 0. Isliye D1 = D2 = 0 jabki Δ = 1, aur koi positive μ condition (16) satisfy nahi kar sakta.

questions.question: Theorem 5 me geometric convergence ka rate kya hai aur θ_λ ka formula kya hai?
questions.expected_answer: Theorem 5: E[Δ(x^K)] ≤ (1 − θ_λ)^K Δ(x^0), jahan θ_λ = μ a / Λ(λ) (optimal coloring me μa/χ_f(G)).

questions.question: Assignment coverage 'a' kaise define hota hai?
questions.expected_answer: a_b = Σ_i q_ib η_ib(h) (marginal assignment probability × local solver quality) aur a = min_b a_b, yaani worst-case block coverage.

questions.question: Work and cost allocation me assignment distribution kaise choose hoti hai?
questions.expected_answer: Ek linear program se jo coverage factor a ko maximize karta hai, subject to har block ke liye Σ p η ≥ a, expected token cost ≤ b0 aur probabilities ka sum 1.

questions.question: Target error ε tak pahunchne ke liye kitne rounds K_ε kaafi hain?
questions.expected_answer: K_ε = ⌈ Λ(λ)/(μ a) · log(Δ(x^0)/ε) ⌉ rounds kaafi hain E[Δ(x^K)] ≤ ε ke liye.

questions.question: Experiments me MA, MAG, SGL aur SEQ baselines kya hain?
questions.expected_answer: MA saare parallel proposals apply karta hai; MAG sirf tab union accept karta hai jab F kam ho; SGL poora program ek agent ko deta hai; SEQ modules ko sequentially visit karta hai.

questions.question: Repair benchmark me kitne task-replicate units the aur kaunse models use hue?
questions.expected_answer: 28 task-replicate units: claude-haiku-4-5 ke 3 replicates (21 units) aur ek Sonnet replicate (7 units).

questions.question: Table 1 ke hisaab se conflict wale 11 units me MA aur MAG ne kitne solve kiye?
questions.expected_answer: Conflict wale 11 units me MA ne 0/11 solve kiye aur MAG ne sirf 1/11.

questions.question: Jin units me first-round conflict nahi tha, unme MA ka performance kaisa raha?
questions.expected_answer: MA ne saare 17 no-conflict units solve kiye.

questions.question: COL aur OPT ne repair benchmark ke kitne units solve kiye?
questions.expected_answer: COL aur OPT dono ne saare 28 task-replicate units solve kiye.

questions.question: Task T1 par MA aur OPT ka failure-count trajectory kya tha?
questions.expected_answer: MA ka failure-count trajectory 21, 5, 5, 5 tha (same transformation baar-baar add/remove hoti rahi), jabki OPT ka 21, 5, 0 raha.

questions.question: OPT ne kitne union evaluations me color candidate select kiya aur kitne color merges audit hue?
questions.expected_answer: OPT ne 37 union evaluations me se 11 me color candidate select kiya, aur saare 108 audited color merges additivity condition satisfy karte the.

questions.question: Nine-unit input-token budget me MA, COL aur OPT ne kitne runs solve kiye?
questions.expected_answer: Nine-unit input-token budget me MA ne 21 me se 12 runs solve kiye, jabki COL aur OPT ne 8-8 (eight each).

questions.question: Chhote repair tasks par SGL ka input cost aur completion time COL/OPT ke muqable kitna hai (haiku model)?
questions.expected_answer: SGL ka input cost COL/OPT ka lagbhag one quarter (1/4) hai, aur t_ver = 0 par modeled completion time lagbhag one third (1/3).

questions.question: 32 modules par SGL aur OPT ka modeled completion time kitna tha?
questions.expected_answer: 32 modules par SGL ka modeled completion time 15.3 minutes tha aur OPT ka 4.1 minutes (t_ver = 0), 2.02× input cost ke saath.

questions.question: Verification latency 0, 60 aur 300 seconds hone par 32-module instance me speedup kitni milti hai?
questions.expected_answer: Speedup 3.69×, 2.42× aur 1.32× hai (t_ver = 0, 60, 300 seconds).

questions.question: Table 2 me m = 4 modules par SGL aur OPT ka completion time kitna hai?
questions.expected_answer: m = 4 par SGL 2.4 min aur OPT 3.5 min lete hain (t_ver = 0), isliye speedup sirf 0.68× hai.

questions.question: C5 graph ke liye χ aur χ_f kitne hain aur guaranteed retained fractions kya hain?
questions.expected_answer: χ(C5) = 3 aur χ_f(C5) = 5/2; guaranteed retained fractions 1/3 (ordinary) aur 2/5 (fractional) hain.

questions.question: FRAC5 use karne par mean retained fraction kitna se kitna hua?
questions.expected_answer: Mean retained fraction 0.5615 se badhkar 0.6167 ho gaya.

questions.question: Held-out repair tasks me FOPT ne mean failed checks kitne kiye aur MA ke kitne bache?
questions.expected_answer: FOPT ne mean failed checks 34.38 se 6.29 kar diye, jabki MA ke 20.02 bache.

questions.question: Held-out multi-round benchmark me kaunsa model use hua aur kitne task-replicate units the?
questions.expected_answer: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct, 48 task-replicate units (16 designs, 3 replicates).

questions.question: Road network experiment me fractional coloring aur ordinary coloring ne kitne units retain kiye?
questions.expected_answer: Fractional-support rule ne 1,617 verified singleton-gain units me se 922 (57.0%) retain kiye, jabki pre-fixed ordinary coloring ne 799 (49.4%); yaani 15.4% relative increase.

questions.question: Road network experiment me kitne regions, paired runs aur CPU agents the, aur har agent ne kitne swap attempts kiye?
questions.expected_answer: 30 nonoverlapping regions (har network me 10), 90 paired runs, 5 CPU agents jo har ek 30,000 balanced-swap attempts karte hain.

questions.question: Route-search agents wale experiment me wall time kitna reduce hua?
questions.expected_answer: Fractional scheduling ne measured wall time median 15% reduce kiya (twelve paired runs me); route-cost changes alag alag runs me vary kiye.

questions.question: Naive merging conflicting edits par kyun fail hota hai? Paper ka example batao.
questions.expected_answer: Do individually useful edits (jaise pricing aur checkout dono discount apply karte hain) saath apply hone par discount do baar (twice) apply ho jata hai, jo error deta hai, isliye union fail ho jata hai.

questions.question: Road network me fractional coloring ordinary coloring se kitne paired runs me strictly better raha?
questions.expected_answer: 90 paired runs me se 52 me strictly better raha, baaki me tie.

questions.question: Held-out tasks me fractional coloring ne ordinary coloring se zyada gain kitne first-round proposal sets par retain kiya?
questions.expected_answer: 48 first-round proposal sets me se 30 par.

questions.question: Held-out tasks me first-round candidate full union se kitne units par better (lower loss) tha?
questions.expected_answer: 48 me se 47 units par first-round candidate ka loss full union se kam tha.
evidence: lower loss than the full union
